articles.summary: MONTRÉAL, QC/ACCESSNEWSWIRE/SEPTEMBER 15TH, 2025 – Loop Industries, Inc. (Nasdaq: LOOP; “Loop”), a clean technology company whose mission is to accelerate a circular plastics economy by manufacturing 100% recycled polyethylene terephthalate (“PET”) plastic and textile-to-textile polyester fiber and Taro Plast S.p.A., (“Taro Plast”), a global leader in thermoplastic compounds, at the forefront of sustainability and innovation […]
articles.title: Loop Industries Announces Offtake Agreement with Taro Plast to Supply Loop™ Dimethyl Terephthalate (DMT) made from 100% Recycled Content

articles.summary: This alliance combines Loop’s Infinite Loop™ depolymerization technology and Hyosung TNC’s industry-leading expertise in advanced textile materials to help brands transition from fossil and bottle-based polyester, to next-generation circular materials.
articles.title: Loop Industries and Hyosung TNC Launch Strategic Alliance to Support Shift by Global Brands to Circular Polyester
